findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Zip archive extraction
 * @description Detects calls to zipfile extract/extractall which may be vulnerable to path traversal
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/virtualenv/zip-extraction
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-022
 */

import python

from Call call
where
  call.getFunc() instanceof Attribute
  and call.getFunc().(Attribute).getName() in ["extract", "extractall"]
select call, "Zip archive extraction call."
findings.hypothesis: Zip archive extraction could allow path traversal when extracting untrusted archives

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name SSL context creation inspection
 * @description Identify which SSL context creation method is used
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/virtualenv/ssl-context-inspect
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-295
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call, string m
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("ssl").getMember("SSLContext").getACall() and m = "SSLContext"
  ) or
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("ssl").getMember("_create_unverified_context").getACall() and m = "_create_unverified_context"
  ) or
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("ssl").getMember("create_default_context").getACall() and m = "create_default_context"
  ) or
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("ssl").getMember("_create_stdlib_context").getACall() and m = "_create_stdlib_context"
  )
select call, "SSL context creation method: " + m
findings.hypothesis: Inspect which SSL context is used to download seed wheels

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Subprocess call detection
 * @description Detect subprocess command execution calls
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/virtualenv/subprocess-calls
 * @tags security
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call, string name
where
  call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(name).getACall() and
  name in ["run", "Popen", "call", "check_call", "check_output", "getoutput", "getstatusoutput"]
select call, "Subprocess call to " + name + "."
findings.hypothesis: Detect all subprocess command execution calls in the package

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Zip extraction call context
 * @description Find zip extraction calls and their argument expressions
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/virtualenv/zip-extraction-context
 * @tags security
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call, DataFlow::Node target, string fn
where
  call = API::moduleImport("zipfile").getMember("ZipFile").getReturn().getMember(fn).getACall() and
  fn in ["extract", "extractall"] and
  target = call.getArg(1)
select call, "Zip extraction " + fn + " with path argument $@.", target, target.toString()
findings.hypothesis: Inspect arguments to zip extraction calls to identify zip-slip risks

message.text: Zip extraction extract with path argument [ControlFlowNode for str()](1).

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Insecure network calls
 * @description Use of urllib/requests without SSL verification or with HTTP
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/virtualenv/insecure-network
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-319
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("urllib").getMember("request").getMember(["urlopen", "urlretrieve", "build_opener"]).getACall()
    or
    call = API::moduleImport("urllib.request").getMember(["urlopen", "urlretrieve", "build_opener"]).getACall()
  )
select call, "Potential insecure network call using urllib."
findings.hypothesis: Network calls that don't verify SSL or use plaintext HTTP

message.text: Potential insecure network call using urllib.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Unverified SSL context
 * @description Use of _create_unverified_context or CERT_NONE disables SSL verification
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/virtualenv/unverified-ssl
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-295
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("ssl").getMember("_create_unverified_context").getACall()
    or
    call = API::moduleImport("ssl").getMember("_create_default_https_context").getACall()
    or
    call = API::moduleImport("ssl").getMember("SSLContext").getReturn().getMember("load_verify_locations").getACall()
  )
select call, "SSL context call that may affect verification."
findings.hypothesis: Find SSL context usage that disables verification

message.text: SSL context call that may affect verification.
